cases.name: 1. mail delivery deduplication: concurrent old and new workers deliver each queued email exactly once
cases.details: Concurrent workers claiming from ops.outbox deliver each message exactly once with zero duplicate dispatches.

cases.name: 2. mail delivery lease contention: active lease prevents concurrent claim; lease expiry enables safe handover
cases.details: Active lease prevents competing worker from claiming in-flight job; expired lease enables clean handover to surviving worker.

cases.name: 3. store finalization deduplication: concurrent finalizers contact provider exactly once and transition to done
cases.details: Concurrent finalizers attempting to finalize the same transaction call provider exactly once and transition store_finalize to done.

cases.name: 4. season maintenance deduplication: concurrent schedulers execute exactly one snapshot, one payout, and one wallet credit
cases.details: Concurrent schedulers running snapshot and weekly settlement produce exactly one outcome in economy.command_outcomes, one payout, and one credit.

cases.name: 5. privacy and retention: concurrent cleanup sweeps execute cleanly without conflict
cases.details: Concurrent retention sweeps purge expired terminal rows and rate buckets without mutual interference or race conditions.

cases.name: 6. single business effect invariant across all domains during simulated full rolling deployment overlap
cases.details: Comprehensive multi-domain concurrency test proves exactly one business effect across mail, finalization, snapshot, and weekly payout.

verification.summary: Legacy duplicate schedulers removed from Game Core and documented in docs/v5/WORKER-HEALTH.md. Proven that only one business effect occurs even when old/new-compatible processes overlap during a deploy across 6 dedicated tests on real PG16.
